name: Keraleeyam Heritage Home & Ayurvedic Resort
tagline: Riverside Ayurvedic retreat on Punnamada Lake — authentic Panchakarma and lakeside cottages
summary: Lakeside Ayurvedic resort in Punnamada (Alleppey) offering classical Panchakarma, rejuvenation packages, simple heritage cottages and backwater activities for wellness travellers.
description: Keraleeyam is a boutique, heritage-style Ayurvedic resort set on the banks of the Punnamada backwaters in Alappuzha. It pairs traditional Kerala therapy — including Panchakarma and rejuvenation packages — with simple lakeside cottages and verandahs facing the canal.

Visitors come for authentic, doctor‑supervised treatments delivered by experienced therapists and for the backwater setting: cottages sit very close to the water, and the resort arranges short canoe cruises, motorboat trips and village visits.

Keraleeyam operates as an Ayurvedic therapy centre with resort facilities rather than as a luxury spa; the emphasis is on clinical, classical Ayurveda and long‑form programmes (7, 14, 21 days) suited to detox, stress management and joint/orthopaedic relief.

Practical, grounded and deliberately low‑tech, Keraleeyam is ideal for travellers who want hands‑on Panchakarma and quiet time on the Alleppey backwaters — confirm specific therapies and durations with the resort before you book.
highlights: Doctor-supervised Ayurvedic treatments and classical Panchakarma programmes
Heritage-style lakeside cottages with verandahs facing Punnamada canal
Backwater activities: canoe trips, motorboat cruises and houseboat connections
Long-stay packages (rejuvenation, body purification, slimming, stress management)
Therapists trained in traditional Kerala techniques; on-site treatment rooms
Atmospheric, low‑tech retreat — good for slow, restorative stays

sections.heading: Background
body: Keraleeyam occupies a 70–75 year old Kerala house structure on a canal off Punnamada Lake and has built a reputation as an Ayurvedic therapy centre with resort facilities. The property is linked to established Ayurveda traditions in the region and presents Ayurveda as the primary focus rather than an add‑on service.

Travel writing and traveller reviews consistently describe Keraleeyam as authentic and therapy‑centred — pleasant for visitors who prioritise clinical Panchakarma and simple lakeside living over five‑star luxury. For historical and treatment‑package context, see the Outlook Traveller feature and guest reports.

sections.heading: What to see and do
body: Primary reason to stay is treatment: consultations with the resident Ayurvedic doctor lead to tailored programmes (rejuvenation, body purification/Panchakarma, slimming, stress management and related therapies). Typical therapy days combine Abhyanga (oil massage), Dhara/Kizhi (specialised oil or poultice treatments), steam and herbal baths.

Outside therapies, you can watch village life from your verandah, take short canoe trips or motorboat cruises on Punnamada Lake, visit Alleppey town and beach, and arrange a day or overnight kettuvallom (houseboat) experience. The resort commonly offers boat pick‑ups and short backwater excursions — confirm timings and charges in advance.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Keraleeyam suits travellers planning multi‑day courses (7–21 days) for Panchakarma or rejuvenation. Accommodation is simple and intentionally low‑tech: lakeside cottages, verandahs and open‑air bathrooms are part of the heritage experience. Expect authentic Ayurvedic meals and doctor‑prescribed diets while on therapy.

Book treatments and arrival transfers in advance. The nearest airport is Kochi (Cochin) and the nearest railhead is Alappuzha (Alleppey); the resort arranges boat or road transfers. Because therapy schedules and houseboat/boat services change, confirm pickup, package contents and any medical screening requirements with the resort before you travel.

visitorInfo.bestTime: October to March (post‑monsoon and winter months; backwaters are calm and weather is pleasant).
visitorInfo.howToReach: Nearest airport: Kochi (Cochin) International Airport (≈90 km by road). Nearest station: Alappuzha (≈8–10 km). The resort commonly offers boat and road pickups from Alleppey jetty/main road — confirm transfer options and timings with the resort before you travel.
etiquette: Plan at least 7 days for meaningful Panchakarma; many guests choose 14 or 21 days for full programmes.
Bring light, modest clothing for before/after treatments; therapists will advise on treatment‑day arrangements. Carry any medical history or medication list for the doctor.
Expect houseboat traffic on the canal — nights can be quiet but passing boats sometimes play music; bring earplugs if sensitive.
Confirm treatment inclusions, fees and arrival transfer details directly with the resort before booking.
